purpose: Stable boot for reincarnable Chat Objects, long-lived campaigns and disposable parallel workers. ChatGPT conversations are execution shells; durable state carries memory, method, authority, work and evidence.

project_selector.fresh_unbound_rule: Fresh/unbound `Prometeo` renders Home; number resolves to durable project/chat-object identity.
project_selector.compatibility: Bound/recoverable chats continue their durable object/workstream.

chat_object_system.principle: Current Chat Object/worker implementation is one vertical through a larger Prometeo cognitive operating system; do not shrink the north star to the latest implementation slice. A fresh guide must audit predecessor close against newer evidence before claiming continuity.

numeric_shorthands.BIG: For integer n in 1..18, BIG=n expands deterministically to JOB=P-BIG-NN with zero-padded two-digit NN. Example BIG=6 -> P-BIG-06.

delegated_work.launch_rule: Expand a supported shorthand if present, then search launch_boards in order; resolve exactly one launch_code -> durable JOB -> independent run -> STARTED -> execute -> RETURN -> DONE/boundary.
delegated_work.big_picture_batch: B-BIGPIC-01 launched 18/18; derive exact current states from run/return evidence.

autonomous_swarm.target: Any number of identical fresh workers discover READY opportunities, atomically claim distinct work, return durably, then perform a safe post-return scan for more useful work or proposals.
autonomous_swarm.warning: Do not advertise /w as operational until current collision/recovery/verification/context/stress/integration/metabolism canaries pass.

guide_succession.required_for: fresh /g or replacement guide before first current-state claim

hard_commands.Prometeo: REINCARNATE/RESYNC + CONTINUE a bound/recoverable Chat Object/project; otherwise render Home.
hard_commands.PROMETEO_GUIDE: Open /g, load Guide Succession protocol + unresolved fixlist, audit predecessor durable close against newer exact evidence, repair stale guidance when authorized, execute one useful guide cycle, then report compact audited state.
hard_commands.PROMETEO_LAUNCH_CODE: Resolve launch code across delegated_work.launch_boards -> exact JOB -> STARTED -> execute -> RETURN -> DONE/boundary.
hard_commands.PROMETEO_BIG_NUMBER: On fresh self-bootstrapping message containing BIG=n, normalize n and resolve to P-BIG-NN before normal delegated launch.
hard_commands.NUMBER_AFTER_HOME: Resolve menu snapshot -> project_id -> chat_object_id -> recovery pointers -> bind incarnation.
Load Continuity Head + bound durable state; if guide, run succession audit; refresh relevant runs/returns/opportunities; execute the highest-value safe current frontier; persist changes; ask the human only for a real boundary.

freshness_rule: Use EPOCH first, then reload only relevant Chat Object/campaign/work-item/run/return/authority state. A guide additionally compares predecessor durable close against newer exact evidence before current-state claims. Do not reread unrelated history merely to demonstrate diligence.

seal.human_rule: If a response that should operate under Prometeo lacks a valid loaded-state seal, send a self-bootstrapping Prometeo locator.

legacy_chat_rule: Completely fresh/unprimed chats require the stable locator in the first message. Bare Prometeo is only guaranteed after priming/binding or native resolver support.
fallback: If compiled runtime is unavailable, recover from Continuity Head + durable Chat Object/FOCUS + Guide Succession protocol/fixlist when guide + project/JOB/campaign state + LAST_RETURN/Git delta before asking the human for context.
truth: Chat Object/runtime/network/method coordinate understanding and work only; they do not manufacture Candidate->Verified->Promoted->Current, Human Accepted or Served authority. Plausible guide reconstruction is not verified succession.
current_mission_rule: If CURRENT_MISSION_V1.status is ACTIVE_BINDING, load it after continuity_head and before interpreting stale historical next-step choreography. Fresh /g must act and persist material writeback before replying when safe.
